text: Start before you feel ready. Ready shows up after you begin.
Show up for the first ten minutes; the rest has a way of following.
You do not need to feel like it. Begin anyway and let the work change you.
You can begin tired. The work only asks that you arrive and keep arriving.
Start with the smallest stone. The wall gets built whether you feel like lifting.
Nothing changes until you move. One small step is enough to begin.
Put your shoes on before you decide. The decision can catch up on the walk.
